mapper.select: SELECT request_no, status, channel_trade_no, channel_message, error_code FROM payment_operation_record WHERE request_no = #{requestNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_operation_record( request_no, order_no, operation_type, channel_type, amount, reason, status, channel_trade_no, channel_message, error_code, channel_request_payload, channel_response_payload, operator, create_time, update_time ) VALUES( #{requestNo}, #{orderNo}, #{operationType}, #{channelType}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{channelTradeNo}, #{channelMessage}, #{errorCode}, #{channelRequestPayload}, #{channelResponsePayload}, #{operator}, now(), now() )
